title: Review session
description: The front matter of a review-session file (#2673, #2650 C10): a group walking an agenda of records together, who attended, and the verdicts the session produced. Its verdicts judge decisions, contracts and drivers, the kinds the session kind names as subjects (#3148, ws-082). Each verdict is also an entry in the judged record's reviews list, whose session field names this session. A closed session is sealed: closed_digest is sha256: and the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the JCS form of the whole session without closed_digest (its front matter as core and the text below it as body, line endings LF, #2546), and chant workspace records checks it on every read (session-seal-mismatch).

id.description: S- and at least four digits, as chud numbers its sessions.

agenda.description: What the session walks, in order: a record by its id, or an item of free text. A record may say what it was when it was put up (digest), the evidence records reviewed with it and any screenshot or recording (#3148).

digest.description: The record's digest when it was put up for review, as chant workspace records --json prints it.

evidence.description: The evidence records reviewed with it, by id: the SHA-256 each evidence file is named for.

media.description: Screenshots and recordings shown with it, each a workspace path or an https link.

attendance.description: Who joined, with the class of each principal. An agent may attend to prepare and lay out; it never gives a verdict (#2650).

roles.description: The roles the principal holds in the session, such as reviewer or facilitator. A quorum that names roles counts only verdicts by principals holding one.

opened_rev.description: The commit HEAD named when chant workspace records new wrote the session (#2693), or null when the repository had no commit yet; the next records amend, review --session or close fills it. chant writes it, and records --since <session id> reads it. Optional, so a session written before #2693 stays valid.

closed.description: When the session closed, or null while it is open.

closed_rev.description: The commit HEAD named when chant workspace records close closed the session (#2693), or null when the repository had no commit. Only a closed session has it. Optional, so a session closed before #2693 stays valid.

closed_by.description: Who closes or closed the session, set by an amendment before chant workspace records close seals it. Optional.

verdicts.description: The verdicts the session produced, in the order they were given. Each names a record of one of the session kind's subject kinds: a decision, a contract or a driver.

record.description: The id of the record judged.

digest.description: The digest of the record text the verdict judged, as the review entry carries it.

roles.description: The roles the principal gave the verdict in, which a quorum that names roles counts. Optional.

at.description: When the verdict was given. Optional.

note.description: Why, in the principal's words. Optional.

follow_ups.description: Records the session started for later, as <kind>:<id> with kind the record kind's name, the form a Chant-Record trailer uses (ws-075): contracts drafted, work items proposed, decisions opened. Optional.

closed_digest.description: The seal, written when the session closes.

recordRef.description: A record as <kind>:<id>, such as contract:C-002 or work:W-004.

then.description: A closed session needs its closed time and its seal.

else.description: An open session has no closed time, no closing revision and no seal.
